air-mass.short: How many atmospheres' worth of air sunlight crosses to reach you: 1 with the Sun overhead, about 1.5 at 48° from overhead, and more as the Sun sinks.

angle-of-incidence.short: The angle between incoming sunlight and a line sticking straight out of a panel. At 0° the panel faces the Sun square on and catches the most light.

betz-limit.short: No wind turbine can capture more than 16/27, about 59 %, of the power in the wind passing through its rotor.

capital-recovery-factor.short: The share of an up-front cost that must be paid each year, like a mortgage payment, to repay it with interest over its lifetime.

carnot-efficiency.short: The highest share of heat any engine could turn into work between a hot and a cold temperature: 1 minus cold over hot, in kelvin.

discount-rate.short: How much less money in the future is worth than money today, in percent per year. It stands for interest and the return investors expect.

hydraulic-head.short: The height that water falls between the intake and the turbine of a hydropower plant, in metres.

learning-rate.short: The share by which a technology's cost falls each time the total amount ever produced doubles.

wrights-law.short: The observation that cost falls by a steady percentage every time cumulative production doubles.

performance-ratio.short: The share of a solar array's ideal output that actually reaches the grid after losses to heat, wiring, the inverter, dirt and shading. Typically 0.75 to 0.85.

power-coefficient.short: The share of the wind's power flowing through a rotor that the turbine captures. It can never exceed the Betz limit.

round-trip-efficiency.short: The share of energy you get back from a store after putting it in: the efficiencies of charging and discharging multiplied together.

shockley-queisser-limit.short: The highest efficiency a single-junction solar cell can reach in ordinary sunlight, about 33 % at a band gap near 1.34 eV.

significant-wave-height.short: The average height of the tallest third of the waves, about what an observer would judge by eye. Used to size wave energy.
